title: Founders Day Celebration 2026 – A Journey of Vision, Service & Innovation
excerpt: On 23rd May 2026, Chirag Global Hospitals proudly celebrated its Founders Day, marking another milestone in our journey of compassionate…
body: On 23rd May 2026, Chirag Global Hospitals proudly celebrated its Founders Day, marking another milestone in our journey of compassionate healthcare, innovation, and dedicated service to humanity.

The celebration was a heartfelt tribute to the incredible people who have stood with us throughout our long and meaningful journey. Distinguished doctors, healthcare professionals, staff members, well-wishers, and supporters who contributed immensely to the growth of the institution were felicitated and honored for their unwavering commitment and service.
The event reflected the spirit and vision upon which Chirag Global Hospitals was built — delivering advanced, patient-centric healthcare with compassion, integrity, and continuous innovation.
A special highlight of the celebration was the inspiring presentations by the various units of the Chirag healthcare family:

Chirag Multi Speciality Hospital shared its achievements in emergency care, critical care, surgeries, and multidisciplinary healthcare services, along with its future expansion plans to provide comprehensive and affordable healthcare solutions. Chiraayu Ayurveda Hospital presented its unique integrative approach towards Colo-Ano-Rectal and digestive healthcare through Ayurveda, Panchakarma, Yoga, diet correction, and holistic healing therapies. The team also shared their future vision of advancing root-cause-based wellness care. The Palliative Care division spoke about its compassionate initiatives aimed at improving the quality of life for patients requiring pain management, supportive care, and emotional healing, while outlining future plans for advanced pain and palliative services.
The event also showcased the institution’s continuous commitment towards technological innovation, indigenous healthcare solutions, research, education, and patient-centered excellence.

Founders Day 2026 was not just a celebration of achievements, but a reflection of gratitude, unity, and the collective vision that continues to drive the Chirag family forward toward a healthier and more compassionate future.

title: Republic Kannada Arogya Samvada 2025

excerpt: Expert Talk by Dr. Rajasekhar M R on Recent Advances in Proctology
body: Expert Talk by Dr. Rajasekhar M R on Recent Advances in Proctology

Chirag Global Hospitals is proud to share that Dr. Rajasekhar M R, Senior Colorectal Surgeon and Chairman, was invited as a Guest Speaker for a Continuing Medical Education (CME) program held on 12th January 2026 at Gomantak Ayurveda Mahavidyalaya & Research Centre, Shiroda, Goa.

Dr. Rajasekhar M R delivered an insightful academic session on “Recent Advances in Proctology”, sharing his vast clinical experience and latest developments in colo-ano-rectal care with interns, postgraduate, and undergraduate students.
This CME reflects our continued commitment to academic excellence, medical education, and advancing patient care standards.

title: Celebrating Art and Wellness: Dr. Rajasekhar Mysore at ‘Arohana’ Sammilana

excerpt: Chirag Global Hospitals is proud to announce that Dr. Rajasekhar Mysore, MBBS, MS, Chairman of Chirag Global Hospitals, Founder and Chief…
body: Chirag Global Hospitals is proud to announce that Dr. Rajasekhar Mysore, MBBS, MS, Chairman of Chirag Global Hospitals, Founder and Chief Proctologist, and Senior Colorectal Surgeon, was honoured to attend as the Chief Guest at the prestigious ‘Sammilana’ music and dance program.

Organized by Sri Sudhindra’s ‘Arohana’ Trust, this cultural event beautifully intertwined the essence of wellness and artistic excellence. Dr. Rajasekhar’s presence added grace to the occasion, emphasizing the harmony between health and the arts.
The evening showcased captivating performances by renowned artists, celebrating the rich heritage of music and dance and spreading awareness about the importance of holistic well-being.
Stay tuned for more updates and glimpses from this memorable event!

title: Guest Speaker at SBI HQ: Delivering a Health talk for Senior Managers
excerpt: Dr Rajasekhar Mysore was invited as a guest speaker at the SBI Head quarter to give a talk on “Self Management” to the senior managers of SBI. The…
body: Dr Rajasekhar Mysore was invited as a guest speaker at the SBI Head quarter to give a talk on “Self Management” to the senior managers of SBI. The health talk was organised by the management of SBI at the head quarters of Karnataka to educate senior managers on aspects of personal healthcare.

Every bank manager is stressed at some point of the day which develops a hidden problem within the body. This stress can lead to lifestyle disorders caused by harmful hormone secretions. Dr. Rajasekhar Mysore explained how all this stress for a job becomes immaterial when we are not in the right health condition to fulfil our daily responsibilities. The talk was super informative & provided intuitive time management techniques to create a healthy work-life balance.
Hoping to see all managers of SBI & every person out there to have a happy life free from all lifestyle disorders.

title: Guest at Opening Ceremony of Jayadev Memorial Hospital
excerpt: Dr Rajasekhar Mysore, our chief proctologist & founder of Chirag Global Hospitals, was invited as a guest to the opening of Jayadev Memorial…
body: Dr Rajasekhar Mysore, our chief proctologist & founder of Chirag Global Hospitals, was invited as a guest to the opening of Jayadev Memorial Rashtrotthana hospital.

The other dignitaries included Jagadguru Sri Sri Shivarathri Deshikendra Mahaswamiji of Sri Suttur Math – Mysuru, Sudha Murthy (Founder of Infosys foundation), Sri B S Yediyurappa (Former CM), Sri Arga Jnanendra (Home minister), Dr. K Sudhakar (Health minister), Dr. Devi Shetty, other eminent doctors and public figures.

Dr. Rajasekhar Mysore extended the staff & management of Jayadev Memorial Rashtrotthana hospital a warm welcome to the community of health service & appreciated the high standards maintained in building the essential medical infrastructure. It is good to see that more people are building hospitals & making quality healthcare available for the average Indian.

This is one more step towards creating a coherent healthcare system in Karnataka as well as India. Dr. Rajasekhar Mysore extended his support by all means to the hospital in the field of proctology by offering his 38-years experience in treating Piles, Fissure, Fistula, Constipation, Colon Cancer, IBS/IBD, Crohn’s Disease, Rectal Prolapse, Pilonidal Sinus & other colorectal disorders.
